阅读代表作品的正文片段，梳理人物目标、主动选择、阻力与关系变化。将角色设定标签和: Read representative excerpts and trace character goals, deliberate choices, obstacles, and relationship changes. Distinguish character labels from actions in the text and identify evidence gaps.
从正文片段检查叙事机制：情境规则、冲突建立、信息揭示、推进与回报是否连贯。只作非: Check narrative structure in excerpts: setting rules, conflict, revelations, progression, and payoff. Provide non-explicit structural analysis only, without expanding scenes.
采样开头，判断信息交代、叙事视角与进入主要冲突前的铺垫是否匹配作品目标；给出保留: Sample the opening to assess exposition, viewpoint, and buildup to the main conflict against the work's goals. Explain what to retain and what to shorten.
比较中段与末段采样的节奏、对白和描写比例，分析重复是否有叙事功能；不要把片段之间: Compare pacing and the balance of dialogue and description in middle and ending samples. Assess whether repetition serves a narrative purpose; do not treat gaps between samples as plot holes.
